pages.text: Made by hand, two bottles of 250 mB each. The chair wants four.

A jar holds 1,000 mB. Your head uses 1 mB per 12 s while you are the jar or it is set down: 3 h 20 min a full jar. In the Head Satchel or a Cradle, none.$(br2)Top up: use a bottle on your placed head, or the jar menu's feed slot.

The $(item)Saline Mixer$(): 1,000 mB of water, a sugar, a kelp, a redstone and 2,000 FE make 1,000 mB in 10 s. Water by bucket or pipe.$(br2)It fills glass bottles in its slot. An empty bucket takes a bucketful, for Cradle and Printer.
